items.title: sources asked for by the tracks; old-style reference lists
items.task: Ingest package for the sources the tracks asked for and the knowledge base does not hold (tracks/kb/HANDOFF.md 'next'; requests of A, C, D, F in tracks/kb/inbox or their outboxes; claims_tracks/README.md lists the thirteen papers named for F and D): find each (arXiv identifiers through harness/bin/nrpic-fetch-arxiv --inspire-query and --meta, generic client name, one lock, three seconds apart; sources into kb-data/raw/arxiv/ only by that tool; nothing in a download is executed), among them a source for the horizons and the conformal flatness of Szekeres slices (Track A), a source for the cell-size error of direct-simulation Monte Carlo and for the relativistic thermal conductivity (Track C); a paper that predates arXiv or has no source is recorded as such with its reference, not fetched from elsewhere. Add them to kb/manifests/arxiv_additions.tsv with group, requester and reason; ingest; the six old-style reference lists that ingest3 left (item, ref or refh paragraphs under a 'References' heading); QA (kb qa run) with the parse rate against the bar; answer each requesting track by an outbox message with locators.
